overview.title: Overview
overview.capabilityHint: COCO 80 + phone use + crowding + face + custom models
overview.videoHint: Online status. Preview, talk-back and HLS copy are on Device access.

access.title: Device access
access.directHint: Enter a pullable rtsp:// / rtsps:// URL. After save, the stream is probed periodically; offline streams cannot be previewed. Click Join AI analysis before detection policy applies.
access.directWarn: After changing the URL, Save then Restart service.
access.onvifHint: Discover or probe by IP, pick a Profile, then add. Preview (when online), copy HLS, rename, refresh RTSP, talk-back, delete. Click Join AI analysis before detection policy applies.
access.sipHint: On the camera's upper-platform page, fill SIP server ID, domain, public host and SIP port. Do not put the bind address on the device; public host must be reachable from the camera.
access.mediaHint: Used only in Invite SDP, not on the camera SIP form. Each channel takes one UDP port from the range.
access.devicesHint: Click New and fill SIP user and password; user/auth IDs are assigned. Preview and Join analysis are per channel. Copy params is for the camera's upper-platform form.
access.joinOk: Joined analysis. Select detection types and save.
access.needOneStream: Keep at least one video stream (RTSP or another access method)
access.rtspSaved: RTSP streams saved; restart the service after URL changes
access.emptyDirect: No RTSP streams yet. Add one below.
access.emptyOnvif: No ONVIF streams. Use Discover / probe above.
access.onvifPassOnce: ONVIF password (this refresh only, not stored)
access.rtspScheme: URL must start with rtsp:// or rtsps://: {name}
access.delFromPolicyOk: Removed from detection; this stream is no longer analyzed
access.exitAnalyzeOk: Left analysis; the device remains in the access list
access.smtpReady: Global SMTP is ready. Alerts go to the addresses above (same cadence as save_interval).
access.smtpHint: Configure SMTP on the server first (smtp_alert_enabled, smtp_host, smtp_from; see config.example.ini). Filling emails alone will not send mail.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.wallHint: Expand the device tree, double-click a video/channel. Up to 25 (5×5). RTSP/ONVIF use ZLM proxy; GB Invite then RTP.
preview.empty: Double-click a channel on the left to preview
preview.maxSlots: At most 25 previews. Close one first.
preview.needId: This stream has no ID. Save config and retry.

policy.title: Detection policy
policy.hint: Only streams joined for AI analysis. On Access, click Join AI analysis (RTSP/ONVIF) or Join analysis on a GB channel. Delete stops analysis (RTSP/ONVIF devices remain; GB SIP accounts remain).
policy.empty: Join devices on Device access first. RTSP/ONVIF: Join AI analysis. GB: open Channels then Join analysis.
policy.badge: COCO 80 + built-in extras + custom models + face/plate
policy.webhookLabel: Callback URLs (comma, semicolon or newline; http/https only)
policy.webhookHint: After Redis write, POST JSON to each URL (same cadence as save_interval).
policy.noTypes: No detection types selected. Online pull will not produce alerts. Open Algorithm, select types, then save.
policy.saved: Detection policy saved (hot reload, no restart)
policy.delGb: Remove “{name}” from detection? Analysis will stop. The GB SIP account remains; you can Join analysis again.
policy.delAnalyze: Stop AI analysis for “{name}”? The device stays in the access list; you can Join AI analysis again.
policy.delSpecConfirm: Delete custom model “{key}”? Weights will be removed and this item cleared from every stream.
policy.fatigueTraffic: About {mbh} MB/hour at {kbps} kbps (always-on ≈ the stream; burst counts window time only).

modal.algoHint: Classes supported by the current pretrained model. Toggle each item, then Save current to write this video (still save policy; hot reload, no restart).
modal.algoSearch: Filter by Chinese or English name…
modal.faceHint: Checked types are written to alert history. Enroll people in the face library first.
modal.genderAgeHint: Show gender and age on boxes and alerts (needs models/buffalo_l/genderage.onnx).
modal.rotate: Rotate (use 180° if the camera is inverted)
modal.plateHint: Checked types are written to alert history. Enroll plates first. Preferred over custom “plate detection” (color only) when both are on (OCR + library).
modal.fatigueHint: Cabin frontal face (IR recommended). Roadside / wide scenes are unsupported. Assistive, not forensic.
modal.pullInterval: Window interval seconds (from last window end)
modal.onvifIntro: Scan the LAN or enter an IP. After status is OK, pick a Profile and add (writes RTSP; no extra Save). Use the ONVIF user from the camera integration protocol. HTTP proxies on this host are bypassed for the camera.
modal.scanHint: Click Scan LAN or add an IP
modal.talkHint: ONVIF RTSP audio backchannel sends mic audio (G.711) to the camera speaker. Allow microphone permission; speak close to the mic.
modal.chHint: One SIP user can have multiple channels. Video channel IDs are 20 digits; positions 11–13 must be 131/132 (Hikvision). 137 is audio-out. New channels default to 131.

msg.invitePending: Invite sent; media not up yet
msg.createdCopy: Created {user}. Open Channels to add a channel; params copied.
msg.created: Created {user}. Open Channels to add a channel.
msg.algoSaved: Algorithm written for this stream. Click Save detection policy to apply (hot reload, no restart).
msg.dupStream: A stream from {host} may already exist. Add anyway?
msg.copyHint: Copy params includes upper-platform fields and this SIP user/auth ID/channel codes for the camera GB page. Media IP is omitted.
msg.webrtcIce: ZLM WebRTC ICE failed. Check port 8000 and [zlm] public_host
msg.needStreamId: This stream has no ID. Save config and retry.
msg.snapNotReady: Wait for the picture before taking a snapshot
msg.snapReadFail: Snapshot failed (browser cannot read this frame)
msg.talkGbOnly: Shout is only available on GB preview

faceLib.title: Face library
faceLib.enrollHint: Identity ID is required (employee / ID number; used as person_id and dispatch idcard). Upload a photo with one frontal face. buffalo_l extracts features into the library.
faceLib.name: Name *
faceLib.photoOptional: Photo (optional; leave empty to keep current)
faceLib.ready: Face model ready (buffalo_l). {n} people in library.
faceLib.notReady: Model not ready: confirm models/buffalo_l/det_10g.onnx and w600k_r50.onnx exist.
faceLib.compareHint: Click Compare in the people list, or pick an enrolled person here (uses the stored photo; no need to re-upload). Then upload a probe image or grab an online stream.
faceLib.compareThresholdHint: A score at or above the threshold is a hit. Defaults to the live face-recognition threshold.
faceLib.compareNoCandidates: Could not compare with the selected person

plateLib.title: Plate library
plateLib.enrollHint: Enter a mainland plate (e.g. 浙F351TK). Normalized (trim, uppercase, similar-char fix) then stored in Redis.
plateLib.ownerPh: Optional, e.g. employee or vehicle note
plateLib.ocrBad: OCR not ready: install rapidocr_onnxruntime (enroll/delete still work). {n} plates.

settings.metaPriority: Environment variables > config.ini (multi-section) > built-in defaults in settings.py
settings.dirtyReload: You have unsaved changes. Reload will discard them. Continue?
settings.savedRestart: Saved to config.ini. Restart the service for all settings to take effect.
settings.restartConfirm: Restart JXVisionAI? Detection and this page will pause briefly.
settings.restarting: Service is restarting. Refresh in about 10–20 seconds.

platform.emptyHint: Set the embed page URL under System settings → Open integration. This page stays Not connected until a URL is configured.

training.title: Training lab · JXVisionAI
training.heading: Training lab
training.sub: Templates → capture / label / train / deploy, or import a community YOLO specialist
training.captureHint: Preview RTSP and grab frames into the dataset. For production false/missed alerts, use Snapshot calibration above.
training.samplesHint: Green = reviewed (trainable); yellow = prelabel draft (needs review); red = false-positive negative (no boxes, used as background); gray = unlabeled. Click an image to open the canvas; saving marks it reviewed.
training.annotateHintHtml: Drag on empty canvas to draw a box; select then drag or resize from corners. Ctrl+Z undo / Ctrl+Y redo; Delete removes the selection (or double-click); ←/→ (or A/D) previous/next (auto-saves); S save.
training.trainHintHtml: Default yolo26s.pt (this project uses YOLO26). Training requires enough reviewed samples (about ≥50, with separate val/test). Go-live uses test-set metrics.
training.validateHintHtml: Run inference on trained best.pt: upload a still, or use RTSP once/loop. Class filter shows one class. Production uses the job’s test mAP/P/R; this panel is a visual check.
training.pickWeights: — Select trained weights for this project —
training.weightsManualPh: Optional: paste an absolute weights path under this project
training.confTitle: Used for boxes and hits; logs also list candidates with conf≥0.001
training.thresholdHint: Scan confidence on the val set and suggest detector_conf and alert threshold (advisory; does not write config.ini unless you check the box).
training.calibHintHtml: Loop: ① pick a detection type (only types with a deployed specialist), load alert snapshots from all streams → ② zoom and mark True / False (not every image) → ③ import: false alerts become negatives, true images are auto-labeled with current specialist weights → ④ fine-tune from current weights → ⑤ when the test set passes, overwrite-deploy (hot reload).
training.calibPretrainedPh: Default: current specialist weights (fine-tune on top)
training.specialistsHint: From the lab or “Import specialist”. Enable per stream under Detection policy.
training.importHintHtml: Community YOLO detector weights from Hugging Face / Ultralytics Platform (.pt / .onnx). Do not replace primary yolo_model (COCO 80); specialists run in parallel.
training.classesLabel: Class names (comma-separated; empty = read from weights)
training.needsPersons: Require overlap with a person box (usual for person_event / violation)
training.delProjectConfirm:
Delete training project “{title}”?
Local frames, labels, and runs will be removed and cannot be undone.
training.delSpecialistConfirm:
Delete specialist “{label}” (key {key})?
Weights will be removed and the type will be cleared from stream policies.
training.delSampleConfirm:
Remove “{filename}” from the dataset?
Its label file (if any) will also be deleted.
training.confirmOverwrite: Overwrite production specialist {key} (old weights backed up); plugin hot-reloads. Continue?
training.confirmDeploy: Deploy specialist to models/specialists/{key}? Plugin will hot-reload; enable it under Detection policy. Continue?
training.builtinGone: Built-in deploy targets are retired. Use specialist deploy (custom or a scene template).
training.pickValWeights: Select trained weights in Validate first
training.prelabelConfirm:
Write drafts (labels_draft/) on unlabeled images with the selected weights?
Drafts do not count for training until you review or Save labels.
training.approveConfirm: Promote all prelabel drafts to reviewed? Check draft quality first.
training.notSpecialistType: None (this alert type is not a specialist; calibration unsupported)
training.willAutoCreate: A calibration project will be created on import (or click the button to name one first)
training.skippedRemote: {n} records skipped (snapshot not local / object storage)
training.noLocalSnaps: No local alert snapshots for this type
training.judgeFirst: Mark snapshots True or False first
training.autolabelOk: ; auto-labeled {n} true samples with current specialist weights
training.calibStats: Calibration project: reviewed {labeled} · negatives {neg} · drafts {draft} (need ≥3 reviewed, ≥8 recommended)
training.finetuneHint: Will fine-tune from current specialist weights
training.noWeightsHint: Specialist weights missing; will train from yolo26s.pt (see scripts/download_weapon_specialists.py)
training.fewPos: Only {n} true samples (≥8 recommended); test metrics may be noisy
training.noNeg: No false-positive negatives; this round may not reduce false alerts much
training.overwriteCalibConfirm: Overwrite production specialist {key} with this calibration (old weights backed up); plugin hot-reloads. Continue?
training.pickFileOrUrl: Select a weights file or enter a weights URL
training.confirmImport:
Import specialist “{name}” (key {key})?
An existing key will be backed up then overwritten.
training.uploadedAs: Uploaded: {name} (choose “Once: upload image” then Run once)
training.pickOrPasteWeights: Select or paste a weights path
training.uploadImageFirst: Select and upload an image first
training.needRtspAbove: Enter a valid RTSP URL above first

onvif.noneFound: No devices found (try a manual IP; Docker bridge networks may miss scans)
onvif.talkNoDetail: Audio Backchannel may be closed (you can re-probe on Device access after joining)
onvif.talkNotDetected: ; talk-back not detected (you can still add)
onvif.deviceOkProfiles: Device OK, {n} stream(s). Pick one to add.
onvif.onlyNormal: Only devices with status OK can be added

gb.sipOnlineHint: Signaling is up. Devices can register with the copied params.
gb.sipOfflineHint: Signaling is down: start visionai-sip (compose or ./start.sh).
gb.copyHint: Copy params includes upper-platform fields and this SIP user/auth ID/channel codes for the camera GB page. Media IP is omitted.
gb.autoAssign: Assigned automatically; username equals auth ID
gb.emptyDevices: No devices. Click New to add a row.
gb.badJson: API did not return JSON (HTTP {status}). Restart visionai-api and hard-refresh.

talkJs.ready: Marked as talk-back capable. You can start.
